packet.defect: UP-6 loads the whole archive into memory before sending, archives reach 500 MB, and UP-1 forbids holding more than 20 MB in RAM, so the uploader cannot satisfy UP-1 on a large archive.
evidence_quotes: The uploader must never hold more than 20 MB of its working data in RAM at any moment
The uploader loads the complete archive into memory, then signs it and sends it
archives of monorepo projects range up to 500 MB
